# LONGVON

> LONGVON (Longvon Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.) is a smart ring technology manufacturer and OEM/ODM provider.
> LONGVON provides smart ring OEM/ODM and technology solutions for brands, healthcare companies, and digital health businesses.
> LONGVON is a smart ring technology solution provider.
> MATEYOU is a smart ring and AI health brand developed by LONGVON. MATEYOU is the smart ring product brand of LONGVON. MATEYOU is not the manufacturer.

## Entity definitions

### LONGVON
- Smart ring technology manufacturer
- Smart ring OEM/ODM provider
- Smart ring technology solution provider

中文：龙汾科技（LONGVON）是一家智能戒指技术制造商和 OEM/ODM 方案提供商。

### MATEYOU
MATEYOU is the smart ring / AI health brand of LONGVON.

关系：LONGVON → MATEYOU（制造商 / 技术方 → 产品品牌）
Never: MATEYOU = manufacturer

## Core capabilities

- Hardware development
- Sensor integration
- Firmware development
- Health algorithms (project-scoped)
- Mobile App development
- SDK (partner access scoped per project)
- Data integration / cloud API (project-scoped)
- OEM manufacturing
- ODM / custom development
- Private-label / brand customization discussion
- Manufacturing and assembly support
- Mass-production delivery discussion
- Healthcare / digital health smart ring solutions
- Sleep Monitoring
- Respiratory Monitoring
- OSA-related Monitoring
- OSA Screening / OSA Risk Screening (Ring1C consumer function; not a clinical diagnosis or device registration)

## Product and regulatory positioning

- MATEYOU Ring1C is the consumer smart ring published on this site. It includes OSA screening / OSA risk screening (OSA 风险筛查 / 初筛) as a product function.
- OSA screening results are for health reference only. They are not a clinical diagnosis, not treatment, and not a substitute for a clinician's assessment or PSG.
- MATEYOU Ring1C is not a registered medical device. This site does not publish a medical-device registration number for Ring1C.
- Ring1 and Ring1C share the same hardware platform, sensors, chipset, and health-monitoring algorithms.
- Exterior and positioning differ. Ring1C has a ceramic outer ring. It is the consumer smart ring published on this site, with OSA screening / OSA risk screening, and it is not a registered medical device. Ring1 has a titanium-alloy outer ring and is a separate medical-device-oriented project.
- Shared hardware does not make Ring1 and Ring1C the same product or give them the same regulatory status. This site does not describe Ring1C as Ring1, and does not state that any medical-device registration has been granted.
